messages:
ash_support: Escalation: customer reporting duplicate billing after upgrading to redwood-sdk v1.3.0 — they see 429 spikiness and then client retries non-idempotent requests, which created doubled invoice lines. Attaching their minimal repro and logs.

ash_support: Repro (customer):
```
# python 3.10
pip install redwood-sdk==1.3.0
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key=\"sk-REDACTED\")
# simple single-turn chat that sometimes returns 429 then client retries
resp = c.chat.create(model=\"gpt-neo-1\", input=\"order status\")
print(resp)
```
They say ~15-25% of calls return 429 then the SDK retries and the backend ends up processing the same prompt twice. They attached two server request ids they saw in billing: r-20260316-11 and r-20260316-14.

sara: Thanks, can you paste the customer's logs (request headers)? specifically looking for idempotency header or request-id.

ash_support: They included headers — sometimes we see `X-Request-Id`, sometimes nothing. No `Idempotency-Key`.

ci-bot: regen-clients job failed on last run. Diff summary: header rename in OpenAPI: `X-Request-Id` -> `X-Client-Request-Id`. Affected generators: python, typescript, go.

jamal: That header rename explains why our SDK idempotency wiring may have missed those requests. More concerning: I spotted a generator config change — `gen-config.yaml` now contains `default-retry: aggressive` from a recent merge. Generator v0.9.0-beta picked that up and produced clients that retry on 429 by default for all endpoints.

kyle: Oof. So two things: (1) header rename broke our mapping for request ids; (2) new default retry policy caused clients to retry non-idempotent endpoints. Together that can cause duplicate billing.

leo: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) ship python hotfix that treats `X-Client-Request-Id` as an alias for `X-Request-Id` and ensure we only auto-retry when endpoint is marked idempotent (openapi `x-idempotent: true`). 2) Add a unit/integration test to ensure we don't retry on `/v1/charge`-like endpoints.

jamal: I'll revert the accidental `gen-config.yaml` change in the generator repo and pin regen CI to generator v0.8.7. Also adding a new regen CI gate to block API surface diffs (header rename/type changes) unless a changelog/migration note is present.

ash_support: Customer asks ETA and whether we can refund duplicate charges if confirmed.

sara: Support process: collect the customer request ids and timestamps, cross-check server logs for duplicate processing, and escalate to billing for refunds if we confirm more than one successful processing for the same user prompt. Finance will handle credits; support should hold billing action until we confirm.

devex-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-987: "regen drift: openapi header rename + global retry policy flip" assigned to jamal and leo, P0.

leo: I opened a python hotfix PR that: maps both headers, enforces `retry_on_429=false` for non-idempotent endpoints, and adds an integration test that simulates a 429 from the server and asserts no duplicate processing. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/python-sdk/pull/790

jamal: Regen CI change PR: https://git.internal/redwood/regen-config/pull/43 — pins generator, reverts default-retry, and adds an `openapi-diff` gating script.

leo: Releasing python-sdk v1.3.1 with the hotfix now. Will run smoke tests and publish to PyPI. I will post the PyPI link when done.

(devex-bot): release python-sdk@1.3.1 published to PyPI by leo

leo: PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/redwood-sdk/1.3.1 (hotfix)

ash_support: Shared the patch with the customer. They ran quick tests and reported immediate improvement: 429 rate dropped and no duplicate invoices observed so far. They're going to monitor for 24h.

sara: Followups: jamal to add regen integration test to detect retry-policy flips; leo to add migration notes for header rename and update changelogs; support to confirm billing if duplicates show up and escalate. Also consider server-side `Idempotency-Status` header to make debugging easier when idempotency header is missing.

jamal: Agreed — I'll add `openapi-diff` failure mode to require a changelog entry for header/name/type changes and include an automated migration note template in the PR checklist.

ash_support: Customer confirms after 2 hours: no duplicate billing entries found, they mark as resolved. Thanks team :white_check_mark:

sara: Good work. We'll keep the postmortem short and actionable and close DEVEX-987 when regen guards are in place.
